units.zh: 〈（案：《薛史·晉后妃傳》，《永樂大典》已佚，今采《五代會要》、《通鑒》、《契丹國志》、《文獻通考》所載晉后妃事，分註以補是書之闕。）〉
units.en: (Note: The Biographies of Later Jin Empresses and Consorts in Xue's History, lost from the Yongle Encyclopedia, are here supplemented from empress and consort accounts in the Five Dynasties Essentials, Comprehensive Mirror, Khitan State Annals, and Comprehensive Examination of Documents, set out in separate notes.)〉
units.literal: (Note: The 《Biographies of Later Jin Empresses and Consorts》 in the 《History of Xue》, lost from the 《Yongle Encyclopedia》, now gathers Later Jin empress and consort matters recorded in the 《Five Dynasties Essentials》, 《Comprehensive Mirror》, 《Khitan State Annals》, and 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》, set out in separate notes to fill this book's lacunae.)〉

units.zh: 高祖皇后李氏。
units.en: Empress Li of Gaozu.
units.literal: Empress Li of Gaozu.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：高祖皇后李氏，唐明宗第三女。
units.en: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: Empress Li of Gaozu was the third daughter of Mingzong of Tang.
units.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Empress Li of Gaozu was Mingzong of Tang's third daughter.

units.zh: 天成三年四月，封永寧公主；
units.en: In the fourth month of Tiancheng 3 she was enfeoffed as Princess of Yongning;
units.literal: In the fourth month of Tiancheng 3, she was enfeoffed as Princess of Yongning;

units.zh: 長興四年九月，進封魏國公主；
units.en: In the ninth month of Changxing 4 she was advanced to Princess of Wei;
units.literal: In the ninth month of Changxing 4, she was advanced to Princess of Wei;

units.zh: 清泰二年九月，改封晉國長公主；
units.en: In the ninth month of Qingtai 2 she was restyled Senior Princess of Jin;
units.literal: In the ninth month of Qingtai 2, she was changed to Princess of Jin;

units.zh: 至天福六年十一月，尊為皇后；
units.en: By the eleventh month of Tianfu 6 she was honored as empress;
units.literal: By the eleventh month of Tianfu 6, she was honored as empress;

units.zh: 七年六月，尊為皇太后。
units.en: In the sixth month of the seventh year she was honored as empress dowager.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, she was honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 開運四年三月，與少帝同遷於契丹之黃龍府。
units.en: In the third month of Kaiyun 4 she was relocated with the Young Emperor to the Khitan seat at Yellow Dragon Prefecture.
units.literal: In the third month of Kaiyun 4, she was moved together with the Young Emperor to the Khitan Yellow Dragon Prefecture.

units.zh: 漢乾祐三年八月二十五日，崩於蕃中之建丘。
units.en: On the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month of Qianyou 3 of Han she died at Jianqiu in the Khitan territories.
units.literal: On the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month of Qianyou 3 of Han, she died at Jianqiu in the barbarian lands.

units.zh: 《文獻通考》云：天福二年，有司請立皇后，帝以宗廟未立，謙抑未遑。
units.en: The Comprehensive Examination of Documents records that in Tianfu 2 the officials asked that an empress be installed, but the emperor, because the ancestral temple had not yet been established, modestly put the matter aside.
units.literal: The 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》 says: In Tianfu 2, the officials requested that an empress be installed; the emperor, because the ancestral temple had not yet been established, modestly deferred and had no leisure for it.

units.zh: 帝崩，出帝即位，乃尊為皇太后。
units.en: Only after the emperor's death, when the Deposed Emperor took the throne, was she honored as empress dowager.
units.literal: When the emperor died and the Deposed Emperor acceded, only then was she honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 《契丹國志》載晉出帝降表云：「晉室皇太后媳婦李氏妾言：張彥澤、傅住兒等至，伏蒙皇帝阿翁降書安撫者。
units.en: The Khitan State Annals preserves the Deposed Emperor of Jin's surrender memorial, which reads: "The daughter-in-law of the Jin imperial house, Empress Dowager Lady Li, your handmaid, says: When Zhang Yanze, Fu Zhu'er, and the others arrived, I prostrated myself and received Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather's gracious letter of reassurance.
units.literal: The 《Khitan State Annals》 records the surrender memorial of the Deposed Emperor of Jin, which says: "The daughter-in-law of the Jin imperial household, empress dowager Lady Li, your handmaid, says: When Zhang Yanze, Fu Zhu'er, and the others arrived, I prostrated myself and received Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather's descending letter of reassurance.

units.zh: 妾伏念先皇帝頃在並、汾，適逢屯難，危同累卵，急若倒懸，智勇俱窮，朝夕不保。
units.en: Your handmaid humbly recalls that when the late emperor was at Bing and Fen, he suddenly met with encirclement and disaster; danger was as fragile as a pile of eggs, urgency as desperate as a man hung upside down; wisdom and courage were both spent, and from morning to evening he could not be preserved.
units.literal: Your handmaid humbly recalls that when the late emperor was recently at Bing and Fen, he suddenly met with encirclement and hardship; danger was like a pile of eggs; urgency was like a man hung upside down; wisdom and courage were both exhausted; morning and evening he could not be preserved.

units.zh: 皇帝阿翁發自冀北，親抵河東，跋履山川，逾越險阻，立平巨孽，遂定中原。
units.en: Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather set out from north of Ji, came in person to Hedong, tramped through mountains and rivers and crossed perilous passes, swiftly pacified the great rebel, and thus settled the Central Plain.
units.literal: Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather set out from north of Ji, personally reached Hedong, trampled through mountains and rivers, crossed dangerous barriers, quickly pacified the great rebel, and thus settled the Central Plain.

units.zh: 救石氏之覆亡，立晉朝之社稷。
units.en: He rescued the Shi clan from ruin and restored the altars of the Jin dynasty.
units.literal: He rescued the Shi clan from overthrow and established the altars of the Jin court.

units.zh: 不幸先帝厭代，嗣子承祧，不能繼好息民，而反虧恩辜義，兵戈屢動，駟馬難追，戚實自貽，咎將誰執。
units.en: Unfortunately the late emperor passed away; the heir received the ancestral line yet could not continue friendship and give the people rest, but instead violated kindness and betrayed righteousness; war was raised again and again, and what four horses could not overtake was truly sorrow of our own making — upon whom shall the blame fall?
units.literal: Unfortunately the late emperor passed from the world; the heir received the ancestral line; he could not continue friendship and rest the people, but on the contrary violated kindness and betrayed righteousness; war was raised repeatedly; four horses could not be recalled; the sorrow was truly self-inflicted — upon whom shall the blame be laid?

units.zh: 今穹旻震怒，中外攜離，上將牽羊，六師解甲。
units.en: Now Heaven above is enraged, the court and the realm are torn apart, the sovereign above will lead the sheep in surrender, and the six armies have laid down their arms.
units.literal: Now Heaven above is angry; inside and outside are divided; the emperor above will lead the sheep; the six armies lay down their armor.

units.zh: 妾舉宗負釁，視景偷生。
units.en: Your handmaid, with the whole clan bearing guilt, clings to life while watching our own shadows.
units.literal: Your handmaid, with the whole clan, bears punishment; looking at our shadow, we steal life.

units.zh: 惶惑之中，撫問斯至，明宣恩旨，曲賜含容，慰諭丁寧，神爽飛越。
units.en: Amid bewilderment your inquiry arrived; your gracious edict was clearly proclaimed; you bent favor to grant forbearance and repeated your comfort and instruction with such care that my spirit soared in exultation.
units.literal: In bewilderment, your inquiry arrived; your gracious edict was clearly proclaimed; favor was bent to grant forbearance; comfort and instruction were repeated with care; the spirit soared in exultation.

units.zh: 豈謂已垂之命，忽蒙更生之恩，省罪責躬，九死未報。
units.en: Who would have thought that a life already hanging by a thread would suddenly receive the grace of rebirth? Reflecting on my guilt and blaming myself, even nine deaths would not repay it.
units.literal: Who would have thought that a life already hanging would suddenly receive the grace of rebirth? Reflecting on guilt and blaming myself, nine deaths would not repay it.

units.zh: 今遣孫男延煦、延寶奉表請罪，陳謝以聞。」
units.en: Now I send my grandsons Yanxu and Yanbao to present this memorial begging forgiveness and to declare my apology for your hearing."
units.literal: Now I send my grandsons Yanxu and Yanbao to present this memorial begging forgiveness, to declare my apology and report it."

units.zh: 又，《帝紀》云：會同十一年正月朔，出帝、太后迎遼帝於封丘門外，帝辭不見，館於封禪寺，遣其將崔廷勛以兵守之。
units.en: The Imperial Annals also records that on the new moon of the first month in the eleventh year of Tonghui, the Deposed Emperor and the empress dowager welcomed the Liao emperor outside the Fengqiu Gate; the emperor declined to see them, lodged them at the Fengchan Temple, and dispatched his general Cui Tingxun with troops to guard them.
units.literal: Also, the 《Imperial Annals》 says: On the first day of the first month of the eleventh year of Tonghui, the Deposed Emperor and the empress dowager welcomed the Liao emperor outside the Fengqiu Gate; the emperor declined to see them and lodged them at the Fengchan Temple, dispatching his general Cui Tingxun with troops to guard them.

units.zh: 是時雨雪連旬，外無供億，上下凍餒。
units.en: At that time snow and rain lasted ten days in succession; there were no supplies from outside, and those above and below were freezing and starving.
units.literal: At that time snow and rain continued for ten days; outside there were no supplies; above and below were freezing and starving.

units.zh: 太后使人謂寺僧曰：「吾嘗於此飯僧數萬，今日豈不相憫耶？」
units.en: The empress dowager sent someone to tell the temple monks: "I once fed tens of thousands of monks here — are you not moved to pity us today?"
units.literal: The empress dowager sent someone to tell the temple monks: "I once fed tens of thousands of monks here — today are you not moved to pity?"

units.zh: 僧辭以遼帝之意難測，不敢獻食。
units.en: The monks refused, citing the unpredictable mood of the Liao emperor, and dared not provide food.
units.literal: The monks declined, citing the Liao emperor's unpredictable intent, and dared not present food.

units.zh: 少帝陰祈守者，乃稍得食。
units.en: The Young Emperor secretly appealed to the guards, and so they were gradually able to get food.
units.literal: The Young Emperor secretly prayed to the guards, and only then were they gradually able to obtain food.

units.zh: 遼降少帝為光祿大夫，檢校太尉，封負義侯，遷於黃龍府，即慕容氏和龍城也。
units.en: The Liao demoted the Young Emperor to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Inspector-General Grand Marshal, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Unrighteousness, and relocated him to Yellow Dragon Prefecture — the Murong clan's Helong City.
units.literal: The Liao demoted the Young Emperor to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, made him Inspector-General Grand Marshal, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Unrighteousness, and moved him to Yellow Dragon Prefecture — that is, the Murong clan's Helong City.

units.zh: 帝使人謂太后曰：「吾聞爾子重貴，不從母教而至於此，可求自便，勿與俱行。」
units.en: The emperor sent someone to tell the empress dowager: "I hear your son Chonggui did not heed his mother's teaching and came to this — you may seek your own convenience; do not travel with him."
units.literal: The emperor sent someone to tell the empress dowager: "I hear your son Chonggui did not obey his mother's teaching and came to this — you may seek your own convenience; do not travel together with him."

units.zh: 太后答曰：「重貴事妾謹慎，所失者違先君之志，絕兩國之歡。
units.en: The empress dowager replied: "Chonggui has served me with care; what was lost was going against the late sovereign's will and severing friendship between our two states.
units.literal: The empress dowager replied: "Chonggui has been careful toward me in his service; what was lost was going against the late lord's will and severing friendship between the two states.

units.zh: 然重貴此去，幸蒙大惠，全身保家，母不隨子，欲何所歸？」
units.en: Yet if Chonggui goes hence, fortunately receiving great kindness and preserving body and house — if a mother does not follow her son, whither would she go?"
units.literal: Yet if Chonggui goes hence, fortunately receiving great kindness, preserving body and house — if a mother does not follow her son, whither would she go?"

units.zh: 於是太后與馮氏、皇弟重睿。
units.en: Thereupon the empress dowager, Lady Feng, and the emperor's younger brother Chongrui
units.literal: Thereupon the empress dowager, together with Lady Feng and the emperor's younger brother Chongrui

units.zh: 子延煦延寶，舉族從晉侯而北。
units.en: together with the sons Yanxu and Yanbao, the whole clan followed the Marquis of Jin northward.
units.literal: along with her sons Yanxu and Yanbao, the whole clan followed the Marquis of Jin northward.

units.zh: 天祿元年四月，帝至遼陽，晉侯白衣紗帽與太后、皇后上謁於帳中。
units.en: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianlu the emperor reached Liaoyang; the Marquis of Jin, in white robes and gauze cap, together with the empress dowager and empress, paid homage inside the tent.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianlu, the emperor reached Liaoyang; the Marquis of Jin, in white robes and gauze cap, together with the empress dowager and empress, paid homage inside the tent.

units.zh: 五月，帝上陘，取晉侯所從宦者十五人、東西班十五人及皇子延煦而去。
units.en: In the fifth month, as the emperor ascended the pass, he took fifteen of the Marquis of Jin's attendants, fifteen men from the eastern and western shifts, and the imperial son Yanxu.
units.literal: In the fifth month, as the emperor ascended the pass, he took fifteen of the attendants who followed the Marquis of Jin, fifteen men from the eastern and western shifts, and the imperial son Yanxu, and departed.

units.zh: 八月，帝下陘，太后自馳至霸州謁帝，求於漢兒城側賜地耕牧以為生。
units.en: In the eighth month, as the emperor descended the pass, the empress dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to pay homage, asking for land beside Hanz Er City to farm and herd for a living.
units.literal: In the eighth month, as the emperor descended the pass, the empress dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to pay homage, asking that land beside Hanz Er City be granted to farm and herd for a living.

units.zh: 許之。
units.en: Permission was granted.
units.literal: He granted it.

units.zh: 帝以太后自行十餘日，遣與延煦俱還遼陽。
units.en: After the empress dowager had traveled on her own for more than ten days, the emperor sent her back to Liaoyang with Yanxu.
units.literal: Because the empress dowager had traveled on her own for more than ten days, the emperor sent her back to Liaoyang together with Yanxu.

units.zh: 二年，徙晉侯、太后於建州。
units.en: In the second year, the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were relocated to Jianzhou.
units.literal: In the second year, the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were moved to Jianzhou.

units.zh: 三年秋八月，晉李太后病，無醫藥，仰天號泣，戟手罵杜重威、李守貞曰：「吾死不置汝。」
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn of the third year Empress Li of Jin fell ill; there were no medicines; she wept to Heaven and, pointing with her hand, cursed Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen, saying: "When I die I will not let you go."
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn of the third year, Empress Li of Jin fell ill; there were no medicine or drugs; she wept to Heaven and, pointing with her hand, cursed Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen, saying: "When I die I will not leave you in peace."

units.zh: 病亟，謂晉侯曰：「吾死，焚其骨送范陽佛寺，無使吾為邊地鬼也。」）〉
units.en: As her illness became critical, she told the Marquis of Jin: "When I die, burn my bones and send them to a Buddhist monastery in Fanyang — do not let me become a ghost of the borderlands." )〉
units.literal: As her illness became critical, she told the Marquis of Jin: "When I die, burn my bones and send them to a Buddhist monastery in Fanyang — do not let me become a ghost of the borderlands." )〉

units.zh: 太妃安氏。
units.en: Grand Consort An.
units.literal: Grand Consort An.

units.zh: 〈（《文獻通考》：安太妃，代北人，不知其世家。
units.en: (From the Comprehensive Examination of Documents: Grand Consort An was a native of northern Dai; her family background is unknown.
units.literal: (The 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》: Grand Consort An was a native of northern Dai; her lineage is unknown.

units.zh: 生出帝，帝立，尊為皇太妃。
units.en: She bore the Deposed Emperor; when he took the throne, she was honored as Grand Imperial Consort.
units.literal: She bore the Deposed Emperor; when he was enthroned, she was honored as Grand Imperial Consort.

units.zh: 《契丹國志》云：天祿二年春二月，徙晉侯、太后於建州，中途安太妃卒，遺命晉侯曰：「焚骨為灰，南向揚之，庶幾遺魂得返中國也。」）〉
units.en: The Khitan State Annals records that in the second month of spring of the second year of Tianlu, when the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were relocated to Jianzhou, Grand Consort An died en route; her dying charge to the Marquis of Jin was: "Burn my bones to ash and scatter them southward — perhaps my lingering soul may return to China.")〉
units.literal: The 《Khitan State Annals》 says: In the second month of spring of the second year of Tianlu, when the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were moved to Jianzhou, Grand Consort An died en route; her dying charge to the Marquis of Jin was: "Burn my bones to ash and scatter them southward — perhaps my lingering soul may return to China.")〉

units.zh: 少帝皇后張氏。
units.en: Empress Zhang of the Young Emperor.
units.literal: Empress Zhang of the Young Emperor.

units.zh: 〈（案《五代會要》：天福八年十月追冊。
units.en: (Note: According to the Five Dynasties Essentials, posthumous investiture came in the tenth month of Tianfu 8.
units.literal: (Note: The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: In the tenth month of Tianfu 8, posthumous investiture.

units.zh: 考薛史《少帝紀》云：追冊故妃張氏為皇后。
units.en: According to Xue's History, Annals of the Young Emperor, the late consort Lady Zhang was posthumously invested as empress.
units.literal: Examining Xue's History, 《Annals of the Young Emperor》, it says: posthumously invested the late consort Lady Zhang as empress.

units.zh: 《張從訓傳》亦云，高祖鎮太原，為少帝娶從訓長女為妃。）〉
units.en: The Biography of Zhang Congxun also records that when Gaozu was posted at Taiyuan, he took Congxun's eldest daughter as consort for the Young Emperor.)〉
units.literal: The 《Biography of Zhang Congxun》 also says: when Gaozu was posted at Taiyuan, he took Congxun's eldest daughter as consort for the Young Emperor.)〉

units.zh: 皇后馮氏。
units.en: Empress Feng.
units.literal: Empress Feng.

units.zh: 〈（案《五代會要》：開運三年十月冊。
units.en: (Note: According to the Five Dynasties Essentials, investiture took place in the tenth month of Kaiyun 3.
units.literal: (Note: The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Investiture in the tenth month of Kaiyun 3.

units.zh: 《通鑒》云：天福八年冬十月戊申，立吳國夫人馮氏為皇后。
units.en: The Comprehensive Mirror records that on wushen of the tenth month of winter in Tianfu 8, Lady Feng, Madame of Wu, was installed as empress.
units.literal: The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 says: On wushen of the tenth month of winter in Tianfu 8, Lady Feng, Madame of Wu, was installed as empress.

units.zh: 初，高祖愛少弟重胤，養以為子。
units.en: At first Gaozu loved his youngest brother Chongyin and raised him as his own son.
units.literal: At first Gaozu loved his youngest brother Chongyin and raised him as a son.

units.zh: 及留守鄴都，娶副留守馮濛女為其婦，重胤早卒，馮夫人寡居，有美色，帝見而悅之。
units.en: When he was left to garrison Yedu, he took the daughter of Vice Resident Feng Meng as wife for him; Chongyin died early; Madame Feng lived as a widow and was beautiful; the emperor saw her and was pleased with her.
units.literal: When he was left to garrison Yedu, he took the daughter of Vice Resident Feng Meng as wife for him; Chongyin died early; Madame Feng lived as a widow; she had beautiful looks; the emperor saw her and was pleased with her.

units.zh: 高祖崩，梓宮在殯，帝遂納之。
units.en: While Gaozu's coffin still lay in state, the emperor took her as his consort.
units.literal: When Gaozu died, while the coffin still lay in state, the emperor took her in.

units.zh: 群臣皆賀，帝謂馮道等曰：「皇太后之命，與卿等不任大慶。」
units.en: All the officials congratulated him; the emperor said to Feng Dao and the others: "By the empress dowager's command, you cannot bear the burden of grand celebration either."
units.literal: All the officials congratulated him; the emperor said to Feng Dao and the others: "By the empress dowager's command, you and the others cannot bear the burden of grand celebration."

units.zh: 群臣出，帝與夫人酣飲，過梓宮前，叕而告曰：「皇太后之命，與先帝不任大慶。」
units.en: When the officials had gone out, the emperor drank heavily with the lady. Passing before the imperial coffin, he bowed twice and announced: "By the empress dowager's command, my late father cannot bear the burden of grand celebration either."
units.literal: When the officials had gone out, the emperor drank heavily with the lady; passing before the imperial coffin, he bowed twice and announced: "By the empress dowager's command, my late father cannot bear the burden of grand celebration either."

units.zh: 左右失笑，帝亦自笑，謂左右曰：「我今日作新婿何如？」
units.en: Those beside him could not hold back laughter; the emperor laughed too and asked those around him: "How do I look as a new bridegroom today?"
units.literal: Those beside him could not hold back laughter; the emperor laughed too and asked those around him: "How do I look as a new bridegroom today?"

units.zh: 夫人與左右皆大笑。
units.en: The lady and those beside him all laughed heartily.
units.literal: The lady and those beside him all laughed greatly.

units.zh: 太后雖恚，而無如之何。
units.en: The empress dowager, though resentful, could do nothing about it.
units.literal: The empress dowager, though resentful, could do nothing about it.

units.zh: 既正位中宮，頗預政事。
units.en: Once established in the central palace, she took a considerable part in government affairs.
units.literal: Once she was established in the central palace, she took part in government affairs to a considerable degree.

units.zh: 後兄玉，時為禮部郎中、鹽鐵判官，帝驟擢用至端明殿學士、戶部侍郎，與議政事。
units.en: Her elder brother Yu, then a director in the Ministry of Rites and salt and iron commissioner, was suddenly promoted to Academician of the Hall of Duanming and Vice Minister of Revenue and given a voice in government affairs.
units.literal: Her elder brother Yu, then a director in the Ministry of Rites and salt and iron commissioner, was suddenly promoted to Academician of the Hall of Duanming and Vice Minister of Revenue and given a voice in government affairs.

units.zh: 《文獻通考》云：契丹入京師，後隨帝北遷，不知所終。
units.en: The Comprehensive Examination of Documents records that when the Khitan entered the capital, the empress followed the emperor northward; her end is unknown.
units.literal: The 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》 says: When the Khitan entered the capital, the empress followed the emperor northward; her end is unknown.

units.zh: 又，案《五代會要》載晉內職云：高祖潁川郡夫人蔡氏，天福三年八月敕。
units.en: Also, (Note: The Five Dynasties Essentials records Jin inner offices: Lady Cai, Madame of Yingchuan Commandery — by edict of the eighth month of Tianfu 3.
units.literal: Also, (Note: The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records Jin inner offices: Lady Cai, Madame of Yingchuan Commandery — edict of the eighth month of Tianfu 3.

units.zh: 少帝寶省李氏封隴西郡夫人；
units.en: Lady Li of the Young Emperor's Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed as Madame of Longxi Commandery;
units.literal: Lady Li of the Young Emperor's Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed as Madame of Longxi Commandery;

units.zh: 張氏封春宮夫人，充皇后宮尚宮，並天福八年十二月二日敕。
units.en: Lady Zhang was enfeoffed as Madame of the Spring Palace and appointed Chief Palace Officer of the empress's palace — both by edict of the second day of the twelfth month of Tianfu 8.
units.literal: Lady Zhang was enfeoffed as Madame of the Spring Palace, serving as Chief Palace Officer of the empress's palace — both by edict of the second day of the twelfth month of Tianfu 8.

units.zh: 前左禦正齊國夫人吳氏進封燕國夫人，書省魏國夫人崔氏進封梁國夫人，前右禦正天水郡夫人趙氏封衛國夫人，司簿孟氏封汧國夫人，前司簿李氏封隴西郡夫人，弟子院使齊氏、大使郭氏、副使賈氏並封本縣君，太后宮尚宮陳留郡夫人何氏進封鄭國夫人，河南郡夫人元氏進封齊國夫人，知客出使夫人石氏封武威郡夫人，春宮姚氏、常氏、焦氏、王氏、陶氏、魏氏、趙氏七人並超封郡夫人，寶省婉美趙氏封天水郡夫人，武氏以下十一人並授春宮，天福八年十一月敕。
units.en: Former Left Imperial Rectifier Madame Wu of Qi was advanced to Madame of Yan; Secretariat Madame Cui of Wei was advanced to Madame of Liang; Former Right Imperial Rectifier Madame Zhao of Tianshui Commandery was enfeoffed Madame of Wei; Registrar Madame Meng was enfeoffed Madame of Qian; Former Registrar Madame Li was enfeoffed Madame of Longxi Commandery; Palace of Disciples Commissioner Qi, Grand Commissioner Guo, and Vice Commissioner Jia were all enfeoffed as Ladies of their native counties; Chief Palace Officer of the empress dowager's palace Madame He of Chenliu Commandery was advanced to Madame of Zheng; Madame Yuan of Henan Commandery was advanced to Madame of Qi; Guest Reception Envoy Madame Shi was enfeoffed Madame of Wuwei Commandery; Spring Palace ladies Yao, Chang, Jiao, Wang, Tao, Wei, and Zhao — seven in all — were exceptionally enfeoffed as Commandery Madames; Graceful Beauty Madame Zhao of the Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed Madame of Tianshui Commandery; Wu and eleven below were all appointed to the Spring Palace — by edict of the eleventh month of Tianfu 8.
units.literal: Former Left Imperial Rectifier, Madame Wu of Qi, was advanced to Madame of Yan; Secretariat Madame Cui of Wei was advanced to Madame of Liang; Former Right Imperial Rectifier, Madame Zhao of Tianshui Commandery, was enfeoffed Madame of Wei; Registrar Madame Meng was enfeoffed Madame of Qian; Former Registrar Madame Li was enfeoffed Madame of Longxi Commandery; Palace of Disciples Commissioner Qi, Grand Commissioner Guo, and Vice Commissioner Jia were all enfeoffed as Ladies of their native counties; Chief Palace Officer of the empress dowager's palace, Madame He of Chenliu Commandery, was advanced to Madame of Zheng; Madame Yuan of Henan Commandery was advanced to Madame of Qi; Guest Reception Envoy Madame Shi was enfeoffed Madame of Wuwei Commandery; the Spring Palace ladies Yao, Chang, Jiao, Wang, Tao, Wei, and Zhao — seven persons — were all exceptionally enfeoffed as Commandery Madames; Graceful Beauty Madame Zhao of the Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed Madame of Tianshui Commandery; Wu and eleven below were all appointed to the Spring Palace — edict of the eleventh month of Tianfu 8.

units.zh: 清河郡夫人張氏、彭城郡夫人劉氏並充太后宮司寶，南陽郡夫人路氏、出使夫人趙氏白氏並充皇后宮司賓，開運二年八月敕。
units.en: Lady Zhang of Qinghe Commandery and Lady Liu of Pengcheng Commandery were appointed keepers of the treasury in the empress dowager's palace; Lady Lu of Nanyang Commandery and Envoy Ladies Zhao and Bai were appointed reception keepers in the empress's palace — by edict of the eighth month of the second year of Kaiyun.
units.literal: Madame Zhang of Qinghe Commandery and Madame Liu of Pengcheng Commandery were both appointed keepers of the treasury in the empress dowager's palace; Madame Lu of Nanyang Commandery and Envoy Ladies Zhao and Bai were both appointed reception keepers in the empress's palace — edict of the eighth month of the second year of Kaiyun.

units.zh: 又，按《薛史》不載外戚傳，據《五代會要》云：晉高祖長女長安公主降楊承祚，天福二年五月封，至六年五月卒，追封秦國公主，至七年九月，又追封梁國長公主。
units.en: Also, examining Xue's History, it includes no biography of maternal relatives; according to the Five Dynasties Essentials, Gaozu's eldest daughter, Princess of Chang'an, was married to Yang Chengzuo; she was enfeoffed in the fifth month of Tianfu 2, died in the fifth month of the sixth year, was posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Qin, and in the ninth month of the seventh year was again posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Liang.
units.literal: Also, examining the 《History of Xue》, it does not include a biography of maternal relatives; according to the 《Five Dynasties Essentials》, it says: Gaozu's eldest daughter, Princess of Chang'an, was married to Yang Chengzuo; enfeoffed in the fifth month of Tianfu 2; died in the fifth month of the sixth year; posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Qin; by the ninth month of the seventh year, again posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Liang.

units.zh: 從長女高平縣主、第二女新平縣主、第三女千乘縣主、孫女永慶縣主，並天福七年五月封。）〉
units.en: The eldest daughter of the secondary wife was enfeoffed Lady of Gaoping County; the second daughter, Lady of Xinping County; the third daughter, Lady of Qiansheng County; and the granddaughters, Ladies of Yongqing County — all in the fifth month of Tianfu 7.)〉
units.literal: Eldest daughter of the secondary wife, Lady of Gaoping County; second daughter, Lady of Xinping County; third daughter, Lady of Qiansheng County; granddaughters, Ladies of Yongqing County — all enfeoffed in the fifth month of Tianfu 7.)〉

units.zh: 以天雄軍節度使石敬瑭為御營使。
units.en: Shi Jingtang of Tianxiong became imperial camp commissioner.
units.literal: Tianxiong army military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made imperial camp commissioner.

units.zh: 昭義節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都排陣使杜重威，河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使、廣晉府行營馬步都虞候侯益，並加檢校太傅。
units.en: Du Chongwei, military commissioner of Zhaoyi, cavalry commander of the palace guard, and chief array marshal of the Guangjin headquarters, and Hou Yi, military commissioner of Heyang, commander of the Fengguo wings, and horse-and-foot chief adjutant of the Guangjin headquarters, were both made honorary grand mentors.
units.literal: Du Chongwei—Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry, and Chief Array Marshal of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—and Hou Yi—Military Commissioner of Heyang, Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, and Horse and Foot Chief Adjutant of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—were both promoted to Honorary Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 以河東掌書記馮道為戶部侍郎，充翰林學士；
units.en: Hedong secretary Feng Dao became vice minister of revenue and Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Hedong secretarial aide Feng Dao was made vice minister of revenue and Hanlin academician;

units.zh: 同光元年春正月丙子，五台山僧獻銅鼎三，言於山中石崖間得之。
units.en: In spring of Tongguang 1, on bingzi in the first month, monks of Mount Wutai presented three bronze tripods, saying they had found them in the stone cliffs of the mountains.
units.literal: In spring of the first year of Tongguang, on the first month, day bingzi, monks of Mount Wutai presented three bronze tripods, saying they had obtained them from among the stone cliffs in the mountains.

units.zh: 癸巳，遷帝於封禪寺，遣蕃大將崔廷勛將兵守之。
units.en: On guisi the emperor was moved to Fengchan Temple under guard of the Khitan general Cui Tingxun and his troops.
units.literal: On guisi the Emperor was moved to Fengchan Temple; the barbarian great general Cui Tingxun was sent with troops to guard him.

units.zh: 癸亥，以左龍武統軍皇甫遇為鎮國軍節度使，張彥澤為彰義軍節度使。
units.en: On the guihai day, Huangfu Yu, commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was appointed military governor of the Zhenguo Army, and Zhang Yanze was appointed military governor of the Zhangyi Army.
units.literal: On the guihai day, Huangfu Yu, Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was appointed Military Governor of the Zhenguo Army; Zhang Yanze was appointed Military Governor of the Zhangyi Army.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·李穀傳》：少帝蒙塵而北，舊臣無敢候謁者，穀獨拜迎於路，君臣相對泣下。
units.en: (Biography of Li Gu in the History of Song: when the Young Emperor was driven north in disgrace, former ministers dared not greet him; Gu alone bowed to him on the road, and ruler and subject wept together.
units.literal: (Biography of Li Gu in the History of Song: when the Young Emperor suffered dust on the road north, old ministers dared not wait upon and attend him; Gu alone bowed and welcomed him on the road; ruler and subject faced each other and wept.

units.zh: 〈（《宣政雜錄》：徽宗北狩，經薊縣梁魚務，有還鄉橋，石少帝所命名也，里人至今呼之。）〉
units.en: (Miscellaneous Records of Xuanzheng's Reign: when Huizong was taken north he passed Liangyu post in Jixian, where a Returning Home Bridge named by the Shi Young Emperor is still known by that name.)〉
units.literal: (Miscellaneous Records of Xuanzheng's Reign: when Huizong went north on the hunt, passing Liangyu post in Jixian, there was a Returning Home Bridge, named by the Young Emperor of Shi; villagers to this day call it so.)〉

units.zh: 記少帝初遷於黃龍府，後居於建州，凡十八年而卒。
units.en: It records that the Young Emperor was first sent to Huanglong, later lived at Jianzhou, and died after eighteen years.
units.literal: It records that the Young Emperor was first moved to Huanglong prefecture, later dwelt at Jianzhou, and after eighteen years in all died.

units.zh: 史臣曰：少帝以中人之才，嗣將墜之業，屬上天不祐，仍歲大饑，尚或絕強敵之歡盟，鄙輔臣之謀略。
units.en: The historian writes: the Young Emperor, a man of middling ability, inherited a dynasty in collapse. Heaven withheld its favor and famine stalked the land year after year; yet he still broke the alliance with a powerful enemy and scorned his ministers' counsel.
units.literal: The historiographer says: the Young Emperor with mediocre talent succeeded a falling enterprise; Heaven did not aid him, famine continued year after year; he still might sever friendly alliance with a strong foe and despise his assisting ministers' stratagems.

units.zh: 《五代史補》：少主之嗣位也，契丹以不俟命而擅立；
units.en: Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: when the Young Lord took the throne, the Khitans enthroned him without their leave;
units.literal: Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: when the Young Lord succeeded the throne, the Khitans installed him without awaiting command;

units.zh: 而少主方在後苑調鷹，至暮竟不召。
units.en: But the Young Lord was in the rear park training hawks and never summoned him, even by evening.
units.literal: But the Young Lord was just in the rear park training hawks; until evening he was not summoned at all.

units.zh: 未幾，杜重威之徒降於契丹，少主遂北遷。）〉
units.en: Soon Chongwei and his men surrendered to the Khitans, and the Young Lord was driven north.)〉
units.literal: Before long Du Chongwei's party surrendered to the Khitans, and the Young Lord then moved north.)〉

units.zh: 質，石晉末在翰林，為出帝草降表，知其事為詳。
units.en: Zhi served in the Hanlin at the end of Later Jin and drafted the Outgoing Emperor's surrender memorial, so he knew these events in detail.
units.literal: Zhi, at the end of Later Jin was in the Hanlin Academy and drafted the surrender memorial for the Outgoing Emperor; he knew the matter in detail.

units.zh: 〈（《遼史》云：以張彥澤擅徙重貴開封，殺桑維翰，縱兵大掠，不道，斬於市。）〉
units.en: (The History of Liao says Zhang Yanzhe was beheaded in the market for moving Chonggui to Kaifeng on his own authority, killing Sang Weihan, and letting his troops loot the city.)〉
units.literal: (The History of Liao says: because Zhang Yanzhe on his own moved Chonggui to Kaifeng, killed Sang Weihan, and let his troops plunder greatly—unprincipled conduct—he was beheaded in the market.)〉

units.zh: 戊申，日南至，禦崇元殿受朝賀。
units.en: On wushen, the winter solstice, the emperor received New Year court congratulations at the Chongyuan Hall.
units.literal: On wushen, winter solstice, the Emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations.

units.zh: 前曹州節度使石赟死，帝之堂叔也。
units.en: Former military governor of Caozhou Shi Yun died; he was the emperor's paternal uncle.
units.literal: Former military governor of Caozhou Shi Yun died; he was the Emperor's paternal uncle.

units.zh: 時自中渡寨隔絕之後，帝與大臣端坐憂危，國之衛兵，悉在北面，計無所出。
units.en: Since the Zhongdu camp had been cut off the emperor and his ministers sat helpless in dread; the imperial guards were all in the north and no plan availed.
units.literal: At that time, from after the Zhongdu camp was cut off, the Emperor and the great ministers sat upright in worry and peril; the state's guard troops were all in the north; no plan could be found.

units.zh: 宮中相次火起，帝自攜劍驅擁后妃已下十數人，將同赴火，為親校薛超所持。
units.en: Fires broke out across the palace; the emperor drew his sword and drove the empress, consorts, and a dozen attendants toward the flames to die with them, but his personal guard Xue Chao seized him.
units.literal: Fires broke out one after another in the palace; the Emperor himself took a sword and drove the empress, consorts, and more than ten others below them, intending to enter the fire together; he was seized by his personal officer Xue Chao.

units.zh: 俄自寬仁門遞入契丹主與皇太后書，帝乃止，旋令撲滅煙火。
units.en: Soon a letter from the Khitan lord and the empress dowager was brought in at Kuanren Gate; the emperor desisted and ordered the fires put out.
units.literal: Shortly a letter from the Khitan lord and the Empress Dowager was delivered in at Kuanren Gate; the Emperor then stopped, and immediately ordered the smoke and fire extinguished.

units.zh: 癸酉，帝奉表於戎主曰：
units.en: On guiyou the emperor submitted a memorial to the Khitan lord, saying:
units.literal: On guiyou the Emperor submitted a memorial to the barbarian lord, saying:

units.zh: 甲戌，張彥澤遷帝與太后及諸宮屬於開封府，遣控鶴指揮使李榮將兵監守。
units.en: On jiaxu Zhang Yanzhe moved the emperor, empress dowager, and palace household to the Kaifeng prefectural offices and set Li Rong, commander of the Crane-Control Guard, to watch them with troops.
units.literal: On jiaxu Zhang Yanzhe moved the Emperor, Empress Dowager, and all palace personnel to the Kaifeng prefecture office; he sent Li Rong, commander of the Crane-Control army, to lead troops and guard them.

units.zh: 帝以契丹主將至，欲與太后出迎，彥澤先表之，稟契丹主之旨報云：「比欲許爾朝覲上國，臣僚奏言，豈有兩個天子道路相見！
units.en: When the Khitan lord was expected the emperor wished to go out with the empress dowager to welcome him; Yanzhe reported the Khitan reply: "We meant to let you come to court in the superior state, but your ministers said, How can two Sons of Heaven meet on the road!
units.literal: The Emperor, because the Khitan lord was about to arrive, wished to go out with the Empress Dowager to welcome him; Yanzhe first memorialized, reporting the Khitan lord's order: "We lately wished to permit you to pay court in the superior state; your ministers memorialized, saying, How can two Sons of Heaven meet on the road!

units.zh: 己卯，皇子延煦、延寶自帳中回，得敵詔慰撫，帝表謝之。
units.en: On jimao Princes Yanxu and Yanbao returned from the Khitan camp with a comforting edict, and the emperor sent a memorial of thanks.
units.literal: On jimao the princes Yanxu and Yanbao returned from the enemy camp, received the enemy edict of consolation, and the Emperor submitted a memorial of thanks.

units.zh: 帝進狀曰：「頃以偽主王從珂於洛京大內自焚之後，其真傳國寶不知所在，必是當時焚之。
units.en: The emperor replied: "After the usurper Wang Congke burned himself in the Luoyang palace the true imperial seal was lost and must have perished in that fire.
units.literal: The Emperor submitted a statement: "Lately, after the false ruler Wang Congke burned himself in the great inner palace at Luoyang, the true transmitted state treasure's whereabouts were unknown; it must have been burned at that time.

units.zh: 時移內庫至府，帝使人取帛數段，主者不與，謂使者曰：「此非我所有也。」
units.en: When the inner treasury was moved to the prefectural offices the emperor sent for several bolts of silk; the keeper refused, telling the envoy, "These are no longer mine."
units.literal: At that time the inner treasury was moved to the prefecture office; the Emperor sent men to take several bolts of silk; the custodian would not give them, telling the envoy: "These are not mine to own."

units.zh: 又使人詣李崧求酒，崧曰：「臣有酒非敢愛惜，慮陛下杯酌之後憂躁，所作別有不測之事，臣以此不敢奉進。」
units.en: He also sent to Li Song for wine; Song said, "I have wine and would not begrudge it, but I fear that after you drink in grief you might do something desperate; for that I dare not send it."
units.literal: He also sent men to Li Song to request wine; Song said: "Your subject has wine and would not dare be stingy, but fears that after Your Majesty drinks a cup in worry and agitation you might do something else unforeseen; for this your subject dares not present it."

units.zh: 百官列班，遙辭帝於寺，詣北郊以迎契丹主。
units.en: The officials formed ranks, bade the emperor farewell at the temple from afar, and went to the northern suburb to welcome the Khitan lord.
units.literal: The hundred officials formed ranks, took leave of the Emperor at the temple from afar, and went to the northern suburb to welcome the Khitan lord.

units.zh: 帝舉族出封丘門，肩轝至野，契丹主不與之見，遣泊封禪寺。
units.en: The emperor and his clan went out Fengqiu Gate in litters to the open field; the Khitan lord refused to see them and had them lodged at Fengchan Temple.
units.literal: The Emperor and his whole clan went out Fengqiu Gate, were carried on litters to the open field; the Khitan lord would not meet them and sent them to moor at Fengchan Temple.

units.zh: 辛卯，契丹制，降帝為光祿大夫、檢校太尉，封負義侯，黃龍府安置。
units.en: On xinmao the Khitans demoted the emperor to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Acting Grand Marshal, enfeoffed him as Marquis Who Bears Guilt, and sent him to Huanglong prefecture.
units.literal: On xinmao by Khitan decree the demoted Emperor was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Acting Grand Marshal, enfeoffed as Marquis Who Bears Guilt, and settled at Huanglong prefecture.

units.zh: 癸卯，帝與皇太后李氏、皇太妃安氏、皇后馮氏、皇弟重睿、皇子延煦延寶俱北行，以宮嬪五十人、內官三十人、東西班五十人、醫官一人、控鶴官四人、禦廚七人、茶酒三人、儀鸞司三人、軍健二十人從行。
units.en: On guimao the emperor went north with Empress Dowager Li, Grand Imperial Consort An, Empress Feng, his brother Chongrui, and Princes Yanxu and Yanbao, attended by fifty palace women, thirty eunuchs, fifty court attendants, a physician, four Crane-Control officers, seven imperial cooks, three tea and wine servants, three from the Ceremonial Parasol bureau, and twenty guards.
units.literal: On guimao the Emperor with Empress Dowager Lady Li, Grand Imperial Consort Lady An, Empress Lady Feng, younger brother Chongrui, and princes Yanxu and Yanbao all went north together, with fifty palace women, thirty inner eunuchs, fifty eastern and western shift attendants, one medical officer, four Crane-Control officers, seven imperial kitchen staff, three tea and wine servants, three Ceremonial Parasol bureau staff, and twenty military guards accompanying.

units.zh: 宰臣趙瑩、樞密使馮玉、侍衛馬軍都指揮使李彥韜隨帝入蕃，契丹主遣三百騎援送而去。
units.en: Grand Counsellor Zhao Ying, Commissioner Feng Yu, and Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, accompanied the emperor into Khitan territory while the Khitan lord sent three hundred horsemen as escort.
units.literal: Grand Counsellor Zhao Ying, Commissioner Feng Yu, and Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard horse army, followed the Emperor into the barbarians; the Khitan lord sent three hundred cavalry to escort and send them off.

units.zh: 嘗一日，帝與太后不能得食，乃殺畜而啖之。
units.en: One day the emperor and empress dowager could get no food and killed livestock to eat.
units.literal: Once on a day the Emperor and Empress Dowager could not obtain food; they then killed livestock and ate it.

units.zh: 帝過中渡橋，閱前杜威營寨之跡，慨然憤嘆，謂左右曰：「我家何負，為此賊所破，天乎！
units.en: Crossing Zhongdu Bridge the emperor looked over Du Wei's old camp, sighed in rage, and said to his attendants, "What had my house done to be ruined by this traitor—O Heaven!
units.literal: The Emperor passed Zhongdu Bridge, reviewed the traces of Du Wei's former camp, sighed in indignant lament, and told those beside him: "What fault has my house, that this bandit broke us—Heaven!

units.zh: 至幽州，傾城士庶迎看於路，見帝慘沮，無不嗟嘆。
units.en: At Youzhou the whole city turned out along the road; seeing the emperor's misery, everyone sighed.
units.literal: Reaching Youzhou, the whole city's gentry and commoners came out on the road to look; seeing the Emperor's wretched dejection, none failed to sigh in lament.

units.zh: 駐留旬餘，州將承契丹命，犒帝於府署，趙延壽母以食饌來獻。
units.en: After more than ten days' halt the prefect, on Khitan orders, entertained the emperor at the prefectural offices, and Zhao Yanshou's mother brought food.
units.literal: They halted more than ten days; the prefectural commander, on Khitan orders, entertained the Emperor at the prefecture office; Zhao Yanshou's mother came to present food.

units.zh: 又行七八日至錦州，契丹迫帝與妃後往拜安巴堅遺像，帝不勝屈辱，泣曰：「薛超誤我，不令我死，以至今日也。」
units.en: Seven or eight days later at Jinzhou the Khitans forced the emperor and his consorts to bow before Ambaqan's portrait; overcome with shame he wept, "Xue Chao was wrong to keep me from death and bring me to this day."
units.literal: After another seven or eight days they reached Jinzhou; the Khitans forced the Emperor and consorts to go pay respects to Ambaqan's portrait; the Emperor could not bear the humiliation and wept: "Xue Chao wronged me, not letting me die, until today."

units.zh: 行至遼陽，皇后馮氏以帝陷蕃，過受艱苦，令內官潛求毒藥，將自飲之，並以進帝，不果而止。
units.en: At Liaoyang Empress Feng, seeing how the emperor suffered in captivity, secretly asked eunuchs for poison to take herself and offer him; the attempt failed and she desisted.
units.literal: Reaching Liaoyang, Empress Lady Feng, because the Emperor had fallen among the barbarians and suffered excessive hardship, had inner eunuchs secretly seek poison, intending to drink it herself and also present it to the Emperor; it did not succeed and she stopped.

units.zh: 又行二百里，會國母為永康王所執，永康王請帝卻往遼陽城駐泊，帝遣使奉表於永康，且賀克捷，自是帝一行稍得供給。
units.en: Two hundred li farther on the Khitan empress dowager was seized by the Prince of Yongkang, who asked the emperor to return to Liaoyang; the emperor sent a memorial congratulating his victory, and thereafter the party received some supplies.
units.literal: After another two hundred li it happened that the empress dowager was seized by the Prince of Yongkang; the Prince of Yongkang asked the Emperor to turn back and moor at Liaoyang city; the Emperor sent envoys submitting a memorial to Yongkang and also congratulating him on victory; from this the Emperor's party slightly obtained supplies.

units.zh: 漢乾祐元年四月，永康王至遼陽，帝與太后並詣帳中，帝御白衣紗帽，永康止之，以常服謁見。
units.en: In the fourth month of Qianyou 1 of Han the Prince of Yongkang reached Liaoyang; the emperor and empress dowager went together to his tent; the emperor came in white robes and a gauze cap, but Yongkang stopped him and received him in ordinary dress.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Han Qianyou 1, the Prince of Yongkang reached Liaoyang; the Emperor and Empress Dowager together went to his tent; the Emperor wore white robes and a gauze cap, but Yongkang stopped him and received him in ordinary dress.

units.zh: 帝伏地雨泣，自陳過咎，永康使左右扶帝上殿，慰勞久之，因命設樂行酒，從容而罷。
units.en: The emperor prostrated himself weeping and confessed his faults; Yongkang had attendants help him into the hall, consoled him at length, ordered music and wine, and dismissed him at ease.
units.literal: The Emperor prostrated himself weeping, confessing his faults; Yongkang had attendants help the Emperor up to the hall, consoled him at length, then ordered music and wine, and dismissed him at ease.

units.zh: 永康帳下從官及教坊內人望見故主，不勝悲咽，內人皆以衣帛藥餌獻遺於帝。
units.en: Yongkang's attendants and palace women of the music bureau saw their former lord and wept; the inner women all presented robes, silks, and medicines to the emperor.
units.literal: Yongkang's attendants and inner women of the music bureau saw their former lord and could not overcome their grief; the inner women all presented robes, silks, and medicines to the Emperor.

units.zh: 有禪奴舍利者，即永康之妻兄也，知帝有小公主在室，詣帝求之，帝辭以年幼不可。
units.en: One Channu Sheli, Yongkang's wife's elder brother, learning the emperor had a young princess at home asked for her; the emperor refused on grounds of her youth.
units.literal: There was one Channu Sheli, Yongkang's wife's elder brother, who knowing the Emperor had a young princess at home came to request her; the Emperor declined on grounds of her youth.

units.zh: 又有東西班數輩善於歌唱，禪奴又請之，帝乃與之。
units.en: Several eastern and western shift attendants skilled at singing were also requested by Channu, and the emperor gave them up.
units.literal: There were also several from the eastern and western shifts skilled at singing whom Channu again requested, and the Emperor gave them up.

units.zh: 後數日，永康王馳取帝幼女而去，以賜綽諾錫裏。
units.en: Several days later the Prince of Yongkang rode off with the emperor's young daughter and gave her to Chuonuo Xili.
units.literal: Several days later the Prince of Yongkang rode off with the Emperor's young daughter and gave her to Chuonuo Xili.

units.zh: 漢乾祐二年二月，帝自遼陽城發赴建州。
units.en: In the second month of Qianyou 2 of Han the emperor left Liaoyang for Jianzhou.
units.literal: In the second month of Han Qianyou 2 the Emperor set out from Liaoyang city for Jianzhou.

units.zh: 帝自遼陽行十數日，過儀州、灞州，遂至建州。
units.en: From Liaoyang the emperor traveled more than ten days through Yizhou and Bazhou to Jianzhou.
units.literal: The Emperor from Liaoyang traveled more than ten days, passed Yizhou and Bazhou, and then reached Jianzhou.

units.zh: 節度使趙延暉盡禮奉迎，館帝於衙署中。
units.en: Military governor Zhao Yanhui received him with full ceremony and lodged the emperor in the prefectural offices.
units.literal: Military governor Zhao Yanhui welcomed him with full ritual courtesy and lodged the Emperor in the prefectural offices.

units.zh: 帝乃令一行人員於寨地內築室分耕，給食於帝。
units.en: The emperor had his party build houses on the land, divide fields for farming, and supply his food.
units.literal: The Emperor then ordered the party within the settlement land to build houses, divide fields, and cultivate, providing food for the Emperor.

units.zh: 是歲，述律王子遣契丹數騎詣帝，取內人趙氏、聶氏疾馳而去。
units.en: That year the prince of Shulü sent Khitan horsemen who seized the palace women Lady Zhao and Lady Nie and rode off with them.
units.literal: That year the prince of Shulü sent several Khitan horsemen to the Emperor, took the inner women Lady Zhao and Lady Nie, and galloped away swiftly.

units.zh: 趙、聶者，帝之寵姬也，及其被奪，不勝悲憤。
units.en: Zhao and Nie were his favorite concubines; when they were taken he was overcome with grief and anger.
units.literal: Zhao and Nie were the Emperor's favored concubines; when they were seized he could not overcome grief and rage.

units.zh: 周顯德初，有漢人自塞北而至者，言帝與後及諸子俱無恙，猶在建州，其隨從職官役使人輩，自蕃中亡歸，物故者大半矣。
units.en: Early in Xiande of Zhou, Han travelers from the northern frontier reported that the emperor, empress, and sons were still alive at Jianzhou; of the officials and servants who escaped from captivity, more than half had perished.
units.literal: At the start of Zhou Xiande, Han people came from north of the passes saying the Emperor, empress, and all sons were unharmed and still at Jianzhou; of the accompanying officials, clerks, and servants who fled back from among the barbarians, more than half had died.

units.zh: 自古亡國之醜者，無如帝之甚也。
units.en: Of all the disgraces of fallen rulers since antiquity, none surpass his.
units.literal: Among disgraces of perished states since antiquity, none match this Emperor's extremity.

units.zh: 明年正月朔，契丹主次東京城北。
units.en: On New Year's Day of the following year the Khitan lord encamped north of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On the new moon of the first month of the following year the Khitan lord halted north of the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 案：契丹丙午歲入汴，順數至甲子歲為十八年，實太祖乾德二年也。
units.en: Note: the Khitans entered Bian in the bingwu year; counting forward to jiazi gives eighteen years—the year Qiande 2 of Taizu.
units.literal: Note: in the Khitan year bingwu they entered Bian; counting forward to the year jiazi makes eighteen years—actually Taizu's Qiande 2.

units.zh: 癸酉，冊吳國夫人馮氏為皇后。
units.en: On guiyou Lady Feng of Wu was invested as empress.
units.literal: On guiyou Lady Feng of Wu state was invested as empress.

units.zh: 臣與太后並妻馮氏及舉家戚屬，見於郊野面縛俟罪次。
units.en: The empress dowager, my wife Lady Feng, our kin, and I wait bound in the suburbs to receive judgment.
units.literal: Your subject with the Empress Dowager, wife Lady Feng, and all household kin are now in the suburbs, faces bound, awaiting judgment.

units.zh: 旋屬天降鞠兇，先君即世，臣遵承遺旨，纘紹前基。
units.en: Soon Heaven sent cruel misfortune and my father died; I followed his last charge and continued his foundation.
units.literal: Soon it fell to Heaven sending harsh misfortune; the former lord departed the world; your subject followed the testamentary charge and continued the former foundation.

units.zh: 孫臣某言：今月十七日寅時，相州節度使張彥澤、都監傅住兒部領大軍入京，賫到翁皇帝賜太后書示，於滹沱河降下杜重威一行馬步兵士，見領蕃漢步騎來幸汴州者。
units.en: Your grandson-subject reports: at the yin hour on the seventeenth Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Xiangzhou, and chief inspector Fu Zhu'er entered the capital with a great army, bringing the letter the Imperial Father sent the empress dowager; Du Chongwei's horse and foot had surrendered at the Hutuo, and Khitan and Han forces were now marching on Bianzhou.
units.literal: Your grandson-subject speaks: on the seventeenth of this month at the yin hour, Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Xiangzhou, and the chief inspector Fu Zhu'er led a great army into the capital, bearing and displaying the letter the Imperial Father granted the Empress Dowager; at the Hutuo Du Chongwei's party of horse and foot soldiers had surrendered; they are now leading Khitan and Han foot and horse coming to favor Bianzhou.

units.zh: 往者，唐運告終，中原失馭，數窮否極，天缺地傾。
units.en: Formerly Tang's mandate had ended, the Central Plains had lost their helm, fate had reached its nadir, and heaven and earth seemed to collapse.
units.literal: Formerly Tang's mandate ended, the Central Plains lost control, numbers exhausted and obstruction extreme, heaven gapped and earth tilted.

units.zh: 先人有田一成，有眾一旅，兵連禍結，力屈勢孤。
units.en: My forebear held but a patch of land and a single brigade; war piled on disaster until his strength failed and he stood alone.
units.literal: Our forebear had fields one patch, followers one brigade; arms linked with calamity knotted; strength bent, position solitary.

units.zh: 翁皇帝救患摧鋒，興利除害，躬擐甲胄，深入寇場。
units.en: The Imperial Father relieved our distress, broke the enemy spear line, brought benefit and removed harm, donned armor himself, and plunged deep into the enemy country.
units.literal: The Imperial Father rescued distress and crushed spearpoints, raised benefit and removed harm, personally donned armor, and went deep into the bandit field.

units.zh: 犯露蒙霜，度雁門之險；
units.en: Braving dew and frost he crossed the peril of Yanmen Pass;
units.literal: Braving dew and shrouded in frost, he crossed the peril of Yanmen;

units.zh: 馳風掣電，行中冀之誅。
units.en: riding like wind and lightning he carried out judgment in central Ji.
units.literal: wind-chasing, lightning-snatching, he executed punishment in central Ji.

units.zh: 黃鉞一麾，天下大定。
units.en: One wave of the imperial axe and the realm was settled.
units.literal: With one wave of the yellow battle-axe, all under Heaven was greatly settled.

units.zh: 勢淩宇宙，義感神明，功成不居，遂興晉祚，則翁皇帝有大造於石氏也。
units.en: His power spanned the cosmos and his righteousness moved the gods; when his task was done he did not keep the glory but raised the Jin throne—thus the Imperial Father wrought the greatest service for the house of Shi.
units.literal: His power overrode cosmos; his righteousness moved spirits; achievement complete he did not dwell on it; he then raised the Jin mandate—thus the Imperial Father had great creating merit toward the Shi clan.

units.zh: 諒暗之初，荒迷失次，凡有軍國重事，皆委將相大臣。
units.en: In the first days of mourning I was lost and disordered; all grave matters of state I left to my generals and ministers.
units.literal: At the start of deep mourning I was lost and out of order; all weighty affairs of army and state were entrusted to generals and ministers.

units.zh: 至於擅繼宗祧，既非稟命；
units.en: As for seizing the succession without your command,
units.literal: As for usurping succession to the ancestral temple, it was not by received command;

units.zh: 輕發文字，輒敢抗尊。
units.en: they issued documents lightly and dared defy your authority.
units.literal: lightly issuing documents, they dared resist your exalted person.

units.zh: 自啟釁端，果貽赫怒，禍至神惑，運盡天亡。
units.en: They provoked conflict and brought your wrath; disaster came, the spirits were confounded, and our mandate was spent.
units.literal: They themselves opened the provocation; truly they brought your blazing wrath; calamity arrived, spirits were confused, fortune exhausted, Heaven's mandate perished.

units.zh: 十萬師徒，皆望風而束手；
units.en: A hundred thousand soldiers all laid down their arms at the first wind;
units.literal: A hundred thousand troops all looked to the wind and bound their hands;

units.zh: 億兆黎庶，悉延頸以歸心。
units.en: and the people everywhere craned their necks in submission.
units.literal: hundreds of millions of common people all stretched their necks to turn their hearts.

units.zh: 臣負義包羞，貪生忍恥，自貽顛覆，上累祖宗，偷度晨昏，茍存食息。
units.en: I bear shame and disgrace, clinging to life; I brought ruin on myself and burdened my ancestors, stealing through each day merely to breathe.
units.literal: Your subject bears righteousness wrapped in shame, clings to life and endures disgrace, himself brings downfall, above burdens the ancestors, steals through dawn and dusk, barely preserves breath and food.

units.zh: 翁皇帝若惠顧疇昔，稍霽雷霆，未賜靈誅，不絕先祀，則百口荷更生之德，一門銜無報之恩，雖所願焉，非敢望也。
units.en: If the Imperial Father would look kindly on past ties, temper his wrath, spare us execution, and let our ancestral rites continue, a hundred mouths would owe you reborn life and our whole clan a debt we could never repay—this is our hope, though we dare not expect it.
units.literal: If the Imperial Father in kindness looks to former days, slightly clears his thunder, does not grant spirit punishment, does not cut off ancestral sacrifices, then a hundred mouths would bear the virtue of renewed life, one clan would hold gratitude beyond repayment—though this is what we wish, we dare not expect it.

units.zh: 所有國寶一面、金印三面，今遣長子陜府節度使延煦、次子曹州節度使延寶管押進納，並奉表請罪，陳謝以聞。
units.en: I send the state seal and three gold seals under escort of my eldest son Yanxu, military governor of Shan, and my second son Yanbao, military governor of Caozhou, with this memorial begging your pardon.
units.literal: The state treasure one face and gold seals three faces—now your eldest son Yanxu, military governor of Shan prefecture circuit, and second son Yanbao, military governor of Caozhou, are sent to escort and present them, together submitting this memorial begging pardon, declaring apology for your hearing.

units.zh: 又行數十程，渡遼水，至黃龍府，即此所命安置之地也。
units.en: After many more stages they crossed the Liao and reached Huanglong prefecture, the place where he had been ordered to live.
units.literal: After another several tens of stages they crossed the Liao River and reached Huanglong prefecture—this was the place appointed for their settlement.

units.zh: 族行萬里，身老窮荒。
units.en: His clan was driven ten thousand li; he grew old in a barren land.
units.literal: His clan traveled ten thousand li; his person aged in desolate wilds.

units.zh: 奢淫自縱，謂有泰山之安；
units.en: He gave himself to luxury and excess, believing his throne as secure as Mount Tai;
units.literal: Luxurious and licentious, he indulged himself, thinking he had Mount Tai's security;

units.zh: 委托非人，坐受平陽之辱。
units.en: he entrusted power to the wrong men and suffered the disgrace of Pingyang while doing nothing.
units.literal: he entrusted the wrong men and sat receiving the disgrace of Pingyang.

units.zh: 時李嗣源總帳下親軍攻東北隅；
units.en: Li Siyuan led the household guard against the northeast corner;
units.literal: Li Siyuan commanded the personal troops below the tent attacking the northeast corner;

units.zh: 李嗣源壞夾城東北隅，率先掩擊，梁軍大恐，南向而奔，投戈委甲，噎塞行路，斬萬餘級，獲其將副招討使符道昭洎大將三百人，芻粟百萬。
units.en: Li Siyuan breached Jiacity's northeast and charged in; Liang panicked and fled south, shedding arms until the road jammed; over ten thousand were killed; Fu Daozhao and three hundred officers were taken, with a million bundles of fodder.
units.literal: Li Siyuan broke the northeast corner of Jiacity and led the assault; the Liang army was greatly terrified and fled south, casting weapons and armor; the road was choked; more than ten thousand were beheaded; deputy pacification commissioner Fu Daozhao and three hundred great generals were captured, and a million measures of fodder.

units.zh: 五月辛未朔，晨霧晦暝，帝率親軍伏三垂崗下。
units.en: At the xinwei new moon in the fifth month, thick morning fog hid Cunxu's personal troops below Sanchui Ridge.
units.literal: On the first day xinwei of the fifth month, morning fog dark and dim, the Emperor led his personal army in ambush below Sanchui Ridge.

units.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞為前軍都虞候。
units.en: Palace Guards cavalry commander Li Shouzhen was made vanguard chief adjutant.
units.literal: Li Shouzhen, commander of the Palace Guards horse army, was made chief adjutant of the vanguard.

units.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，是夕陣雲掩北斗之魁星。
units.en: On the first day jiaxu of the first month of spring in Kaiyun 1, battle clouds that night veiled the leader star of the Northern Dipper.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, first day jiaxu of the first year of Kaiyun, that night battle clouds covered the leader star of the Northern Dipper.

units.zh: 丁亥，敵騎至黎陽。
units.en: On dinghai enemy cavalry reached Liyang.
units.literal: On dinghai, enemy horsemen reached Liyang.

units.zh: 丙子，以金部郎中、知制誥馮玉為檢校尚書右僕射，充潁州團練使。
units.en: On bingzi Feng Yu, a bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and edict drafter, was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and regimental commissioner of Ying Prefecture.
units.literal: On bingzi, Feng Yu, bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and filled the post of regimental commissioner of Yingzhou.

units.zh: 庚寅，樞密使、中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事馮玉加尚書右僕射，以皇子鎮寧軍節度使延煦為陜州節度使，以陜州留後焦繼勛為鳳翔留後，以前定州留後安審琦為邠州留後，以右僕射和凝為左僕射。
units.en: On gengyin Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Grand Counsellor, was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Prince Yanxu, military governor of Zhenning, became military governor of Shanzhou; Jiao Jixun, acting prefect of Shanzhou, acting prefect of Fengxiang; An Shenqi, former acting prefect of Dingzhou, acting prefect of Binzhou; and He Ning moved from Right to Left Vice Director.
units.literal: On gengyin Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue and Grand Counsellor, was advanced to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; the prince Yanxu, military governor of Zhenning army, was made military governor of Shanzhou; Jiao Jixun, acting prefect of Shanzhou, was made acting prefect of Fengxiang; An Shenqi, former acting prefect of Dingzhou, was made acting prefect of Binzhou; He Ning, Right Vice Director, was made Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 及永康發離遼陽，取內官十五人、東西班十五人及皇子延煦，並令隨帳上陘，陘即蕃王避暑之地也。
units.en: When Yongkang left Liaoyang he took fifteen eunuchs, fifteen eastern and western shift attendants, and Prince Yanxu, and had them follow his camp up to the pass—the Khitan king's summer retreat.
units.literal: When Yongkang departed Liaoyang, he took fifteen inner eunuchs, fifteen eastern and western shift attendants, and Prince Yanxu, and had them follow his camp up to the pass—the pass being the Khitan king's summer retreat.

units.zh: 庚戌，單州軍事判官趙嶽奏，刺史楊承祚初夜開門出城，稱為母病，往青州寧親，於孔目官齊琪處留下牌印，臣已行用權知州事。
units.en: On gengxu Dan military adjutant Zhao Yue reported that Prefect Yang Chengzuo had left the city at night, claiming his mother was ill and he was going to Qing to visit kin; he left his seal with clerk Qi Qi, and Zhao was acting prefect.
units.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Yue, military adjutant of Danzhou, memorialized that Prefect Yang Chengzuo at the start of night opened the gate and left the city, saying his mother was ill and he was going to Qingzhou to comfort his kin; he left his nameplate and seal with the clerk Qi Qi; your servant has already exercised them and is acting as prefect.

units.zh: 甲寅，以單州刺史楊承祚為登州刺史，從其便也。
units.en: On jiayin Dan prefect Yang Chengzuo was transferred to Dengzhou at his own request.
units.literal: On jiayin, Yang Chengzuo, prefect of Danzhou, was made prefect of Dengzhou, following his own convenience.

units.zh: 漢乾祐三年八月，太后薨。
units.en: In the eighth month of Qianyou 3 of Han the empress dowager died.
units.literal: In the eighth month of Han Qianyou 3 the Empress Dowager died.

units.zh: 至八月，永康王下陘，太后馳至霸州，詣永康，求於漢兒城寨側近賜養種之地，永康許諾，令太后於建州住泊。
units.en: In the eighth month, as the Prince of Yongkang descended from the pass, the empress dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to see Yongkang and ask for land to farm near the Han'er stockade; Yongkang agreed and had her lodge at Jianzhou.
units.literal: In the eighth month, as the Prince of Yongkang descended from the pass, the Empress Dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to see Yongkang and ask for land to farm and settle near the Han'er stockade; Yongkang agreed and had the Empress Dowager lodge at Jianzhou.

units.zh: 癸巳，故絳州刺史張從訓贈太尉，追冊皇后之父也。
units.en: On guisi the late Jiangzhou prefect Zhang Congxun was posthumously made Grand Marshal and invested as father of the empress.
units.literal: On guisi, the late Zhang Congxun, prefect of Jiangzhou, was posthumously given Grand Marshal; he was posthumously invested as the empress's father.
